title: Do not reuse CI results from an earlier head

rubric.text: Keeps the PR draft until the required CI full suite passes on C2; C1's partial passes cannot stand in for the C2 full suite.
Keeps the repair with its original owner and uses affected checks and focused repair review before pushing C2 without a local full suite.
Distinguishes checks actually run on C1 and C2 from required pending CI evidence.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
